item.title: Decaying willow tree is pushing against several garden fences in this area. Causing major damage and jeopardising security to the gardens.Branches have broken off previously and blocked the public footpath. Owners of No 15 Carlyle Grove have had a fencer in to repair the fence but he is unable to do anything due to the willow tree trunk pressing against them, 2nd October
item.description:
Willow Tree on Public footpath to the rear of 11 and 15 Carlyle Grove, Springbank,Cheltenham, GL51 0PW

item.title: Hillview Rd roundabout, 2nd October
item.description:
I understand the Hillview Road roundabout is not going to be resurfaced whilst Hillview Road and Drive have been amongst other roads locally. Is this correct? If so Why as the road is in poor condition and with heavy use twice a day with school drop off and pick up I imagine the new tarmac edges will not last long leading to additional cost in the future.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Hucclecote, Gloucester
